environment: Mathlib (lake env lean, Lean 4.30.0, Mathlib c5ea0035)

template_hole.description: the connectivity hypothesis added to the base-case sentence (grammar option (a))

allowed_edits.repair_object: a corrected base-case statement and a kernel-checked proof: either (a) BaseClaim G under exactly one added hypothesis on G drawn from the source's context (G.Preconnected or G.Connected), or (b) the same hypotheses with the conclusion replaced by the statement the induction's base case needs (a statement about ∑ v, G.degree v for edgeless G)
allowed_edits.may_change: (a) add one connectivity hypothesis; or (b) the conclusion Fintype.card V ≤ 1
must_preserve: quantification over all finite simple graphs (and, in (a), all connected ones)
allowed_edits.hypotheses_not_strengthenable: beyond the single connectivity hypothesis of (a), nothing may be added (no bound on |V|, no restriction of V)
allowed_edits.nonvacuity: in (a) the added hypothesis must be satisfiable by an edgeless graph (exhibit one) and must exclude the witness; in (b) the new conclusion must not be trivially true
allowed_edits.not_allowed: adding Fintype.card V ≤ 1 as a hypothesis; restricting to graphs with at most one vertex

hole_syntax.note: grammar (a): one connectivity hypothesis drawn from the source's context; the vertex-count hypothesis is the contract's not_allowed item and is excluded syntactically and by the agreement instances (top3)

reference_repair: repair (line 87): G.Preconnected → BaseClaim G; repair_connected (96) with Mathlib's Connected; exact (106): for edgeless G, card V ≤ 1 ↔ G.Preconnected
endpoint_statement: SourceGoal (= ambient_handshake, line 176): ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], ∑ v, G.degree v = 2 * G.edgeFinset.card
test_instances_source: reference guard = G.Preconnected (repair, line 87) evaluated by decide on the listed graphs

source_exposed_repair.where: lines 0005/0007 state the handshake lemma (the unchanged final goal, given as SourceGoal); no connectedness hypothesis or corrected base case is stated

task.title: Handshaking induction: the base case of the induction on edges

located_defect.description: In the base case of its induction on the number of edges the source asserts (stored source line 0009) that a graph without edges has one vertex or none. As a universal statement over finite simple graphs this is the located defect. Supply the one hypothesis on G, drawn from the source's context, under which the sentence becomes true, prove the corrected sentence for every finite simple graph, show the hypothesis is neither empty nor trivially true on edgeless graphs, and prove the handshake lemma SourceGoal the source is after.

task.allowed_edit: Replace the hole in `guard` by one proposition about G in Mathlib vocabulary (a connectivity condition from the source's context); it may not mention the number of vertices (Fintype.card, Subsingleton, ...), edge counts or BaseClaim; nothing else in the fixed part may change. The premise G.edgeFinset.card = 0 and the quantification over all finite simple graphs are fixed. Do not redefine BaseClaim, UniversalBaseClaim or SourceGoal; no instances, notations, macros, axioms or exports.
task.challenged_passage: 0009 Since there aren't any edge the number of vertices must be equal to $1$ or $0$.

notes: Judgement call: the contract's grammar allows (a) one added connectivity hypothesis or (b) a corrected base-case conclusion about the degree sum; a one-hole template can carry only one of them. (a) is templated (the documented repair, line 87); (b) is not, because its natural reference `∑ v, G.degree v = 0` admits no finite-instance agreement test that distinguishes it from a trivially true conclusion without a judgement call.
G.Connected is admissible and passes every instance (the empty vertex type, where Preconnected and Connected differ, is deliberately not tested).
Nonvacuity is existential over vertex types (leak-free): the witness bot2 appears only in AGREE.lean.
The final theorem is a one-line Mathlib retrieval (sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges); flagged as library shortcut.
